title: first100-command-freeze
description: Sole production command truth source for First-100 verification (maintainer decision B4). Supersedes spec/first100-command-registry.json. (epic, stage) is a unique key: first-frozen-wins, a duplicate (epic, stage) pair invalidates the whole entry. Append-only: entries are never edited or removed after freeze, only appended.

stage.description: A/B/C/D ledger stage label per 100-row-program-ledger.md §4 (A=C, B=P, C=U, D=F).

argv.description: Exact argv, frozen with a verbose reporter (e.g. vitest --reporter=verbose or --reporter=json) so the verifier can grep raw logs by named case title.

vitestConfig.description: Explicit vitest config path when the default does not discover the target tests (e.g. vitest.e2e.config.ts). Optional; omit when the default config applies.

expectExit.description: Expected process exit code for a GREEN observation on this (epic, stage).

expectCases.description: Named case titles, 1:1 with this epic's acceptance[] entries for this stage (never a bare count). The verifier greps the hashed raw log for each title to confirm it is present and passing; this closes the 'one always-true case lights up the whole cell' cheat path.

files.description: Test file path(s) this argv exercises. Must fall inside the epic's registry files[] (append-only overlay additions allowed); registry fixtures{} template paths are void placeholders and never satisfy this.

treeSha.description: Tree SHA the dry-run was proven against, unmodified (pre-implementation).

testsDiscovered.description: Number of tests this argv discovered on the unmodified tree at treeSha, proving the argv is not a 0-test no-op (B4(d)).

coveredStages.description: Maintainer decision BLOCKED-002 (2026-09-01): additional (epic, stage) ledger cells this one entry's observation also greens, beyond the entry's own primary epic/stage. Every extra cell must be in the SAME epic, must have no dedicated test file among its own wave-map-declared files[] (tests/first100/registry.json's stages[stage].files), and every one of its declared files must appear as a literal path-string reference inside this entry's frozen argv test file(s) -- enforced by scripts/first100/generate-specs.ts's checkSharedStageCoverage(), never a free-text/Writer-supplied claim. Absent, this entry covers only its own epic/stage (the original B7(1) one-cell-one-observation behavior, unchanged).

supplements.description: Maintainer decision BLOCKED-005 (2026-09-01): marks this entry as a SUPPLEMENT that adds new named expectCases into a later-discovered acceptance-coverage gap, without re-freezing (or invalidating) the already-frozen (epic, stage) pair it supplements. supplements.epic/supplements.stage must equal this entry's own epic/stage (the pair being supplemented); supplementSeq then disambiguates the entry's unique key from the primary entry's plain (epic, stage) key and from any other supplement of the same pair. Never edits or greens the pointed-to cell's own state -- only contributes expectCases titles to predicate (i)'s (coverage-closure) union. Mechanically validated by scripts/first100/generate-specs.ts's checkSupplementalEntry().

supplementSeq.description: Required when supplements is present: 1-based sequence number making this entry's unique key (epic, stage, supplementSeq) distinct from the primary (epic, stage) entry it supplements. Absent on a primary (non-supplement) entry.

mutationDescription.description: What was locally, never-committed mutated in the covered behavior to prove this supplement's new case is not vacuously true.

failureSummary.description: The new case's real failure output observed against the mutated behavior, before the mutation was reverted.

sensitivityProof.description: Maintainer decision BLOCKED-005 hardening clause (2026-09-01): mandatory on any supplement entry whose case follows the 'coverage completion' path (the covered behavior already exists, so genuine RED against the unmodified tree is unobtainable) -- proves the new case actually detects a broken version of the behavior it claims to cover, closing the 'one always-true case vacuously completes any acceptance index' gap. A supplement that instead obtains genuine RED (dryRunProof's tree already fails the new case pre-implementation) is exempt; this field is then omitted.
